## History

John Douglas courted [Janet](../character/janet.md) for twenty years, regularly visiting her without making a formal proposal. His long hesitation was caused by his elderly mother, who forced him to promise he would wait until after her death before marrying or explaining his delay to anyone. After his mother passed away, John went to [Janet](../character/janet.md) and proposed to her, revealing the secret promise that had held him back.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P10](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0010), [v3 ch.Douglas P29](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0029), [v3 ch.Coming” P4](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0004), [v3 ch.Coming” P8](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0008), +7 more_

## Relationships

### [Janet](../character/janet.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/janet--john-douglas.md)

[Janet](../character/janet.md) is John Douglas's long-time romantic interest, whom he visited for twenty years before proposing. Their relationship suffered from years of unspoken tension and a brief rupture when [Janet](../character/janet.md) rejected his escort after a prayer meeting, leaving John heartbroken. They finally became engaged after John's mother passed away, allowing him to explain that his mother had forced him to delay his proposal and keep the reason secret until her death.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P8](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0008), +10 more_
